verdict.summary_en: Boise Semiconductor order acknowledgement OA26547763 for Soony Interactive GmbH PO 4500318602 (dated 2025-12-29). It confirms two lines of CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5 at 6.11 USD each: 10,000 pcs for 2026-01-28 and 9,000 pcs for 2026-02-04 (19,000 total). Terms are EXW Boise, NET30. The document is clean print with no corrections.
red_flags: Delivery terms contradict themselves: the document says EXW Boise and that DDP is not agreed, but also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays freight, so the buyer should clarify who bears these costs and whether they will be invoiced.
The document has no issue date. The only date near the header is the customer PO date, 2025-12-29.
The document shows no unit of measure for quantities, and no ordered quantity to compare with the confirmed quantity.
The order is split into two deliveries on different dates (2026-01-28 and 2026-02-04).
observations: Single-page, fully printed document with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The description is wrapped over three lines in the table; it reads 'Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5'.
Quantities use English comma thousands separators (10,000 and 9,000).
